turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, am I speaking with Mr. Singh from Pune?

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Yes, this is he. Who is calling please?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I am Anjali from the Global Task Management team. I am calling regarding your application for the online rating part-time job.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Application? I do not remember applying for any job, beta.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: It might have been through a social media ad you clicked, sir. It is very simple work where you just like products and earn daily commissions.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: I am retired, I do not know these things. How much can a person earn?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: You can earn five thousand rupees a day. In fact, I have already credited a small bonus to your trial account to show you it is real.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Really? But how do I take this money out of the account?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: That is the thing, sir. To unlock the withdrawal gateway, you just need to pay a one-time security activation fee of twenty five thousand rupees.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Twenty five thousand? That is a lot of money for a simple job.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Do not worry, sir. Once you pay this, you will get your bonus and the fee back immediately along with your first week's salary.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: I will have to ask my son first. Can you call me tomorrow?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: The offer expires in two hours, Mr. Singh. Just send the amount via UPI now and I will process the full payment to your bank instantly.
